propositions: test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning stubs field endpoint to omit Epic Link, causing readiness poll to expire against production 120-second budget instead of failing deterministically
await_required_fields loops with 1-second poll interval and expiry check before sleep, so stub test performs ~120 reads and ~120 real-time sleeps despite deterministic failure condition
JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable already controls field readiness timeout and is read by _field_ready_timeout before falling back to FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S constant
Setting JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT to 0 makes poll expiry deterministic: loop breaks after exactly one attempt without calling sleep, enabling poll-count assertion as guard
Fix reduces test from 120.38s to <0.005s with zero-budget environment override and exact one-poll assertion, following established patterns in Kubernetes and tenacity
